senses.gloss: f. (מעס, denom. of עִיסָה) a paste made of flour on which boiling water is poured, contrad. to חֲלִיטָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Challah 1:6">Ḥall. I, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 37b:5">Pes. 37ᵇ</cite> (Ms. O. <he>המעסה</he>); <cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 5:2">Eduy. V, 2</cite> (Ms. M. <he>המעסה</he>); a. e., v. <cite ref="H01040"><he>חֲלִיטָה</he> II</cite>.
